tools_used: CourtListener MCP search + read_document (First Circuit opinion 26-1212)
WebFetch (supremecourt.gov stay opposition PDF; one commentary post)
pypdf via uv run --with for PDF text extraction
helpful: The provisioned application.txt was clean and complete.
The statpack merits table with the excluded column made the pooled baseline a two-line computation.
CourtListener MCP had the First Circuit opinion the day it issued; chunked read_document worked well.
gaps: WebFetch returns supremecourt.gov PDFs as raw binary; I had to extract text with pypdf myself. A provisioned text of the response to the application (it is in the snapshot) would have saved several calls.

fedcourts query has no stage/kind filter for merits priors (e.g. granted cases where the Court had earlier granted the applicant a stay); a recency-ranked query returned mostly extension applications.
No statpack cut of the merits disturbed rate by petitioner class (federal government as petitioner) or by prior emergency-docket relief, which is the conditioning that actually drove this forecast.
notes: The corpus query surfaced this case's own row (cert granted 2026-09-29, undecided) and its linked application docket 26A406; nothing outcome-revealing exists yet.
